note: Question catalog for LLM decisions (process Q). Callers use ids only. Changing any text of a question requires bumping its version, because a rewritten question is a different question and its calibration no longer applies; python/tests/test_futures_llm_decisions.py pins a hash per id@version. Each question declares the STATE fields it needs (names from the registry STATE_FIELDS in futures_llm_decisions.py); adding a question, any number of options or any of the three types (choice, bool, score) needs no code change. Questions with "scope": "news" are asked by the news process N (python/balancita_engine/futures_news.py) about one news item, whose sanitized headline and summary are the STATE; they have no state_fields and Q never asks them (Q loads only the default "verdict" scope). The same id/version rules and pins apply (python/tests/test_futures_news.py).

questions.instruction: Using only the normalized market state above, where is the price most likely to be one hour from now compared with the last close?

options.description: higher by more than 15 basis points
lower by more than 15 basis points
within 15 basis points of the last close in either direction

questions.instruction: Each strategy in strategy_signals gives its probabilities to buy, hold or sell now, with its most likely action in parentheses, and strategy_consensus is their average. Weighing every strategy together with the normalized market state, which action is most likely to be right now?

You hold the open position described in position. It has no stop loss and no take profit: you alone decide when it ends, and whatever it is worth at the moment you close it becomes your realized gain or loss, after costs. Using the position, the normalized market state and exit_lessons, which is the better choice now?

options.description: keep the position open and decide again later
close the position now and realize its current result

questions.instruction: Read the news item above. How relevant is it to the price of Bitcoin over the next few hours?

options.description: no plausible effect on the Bitcoin price
a clear effect on crypto markets
a major and immediate effect on Bitcoin

questions.instruction: Read the news item above. Over the next few hours, is its likely effect on crypto prices bullish, bearish or neutral?

options.description: likely to push crypto prices up
likely to push crypto prices down
no clear direction, or no effect
